name: Ample Classes Are Closed under Boolean Substitution
statement: Let the nonempty outer class have nonempty distinct sections and let the test be nonempty and proper. The substituted class is ample exactly when both the outer class and the test are ample. Empty, full, or equal-section boundary cases reduce to sections and products.
proof: A crossing cube edge in the test recovers the outer class as a section, and fixing a word in the symmetric difference of the outer sections recovers the test or its complement. For sufficiency, the exact shattering formula splits supports among the intersection of the two shores and the two individual shores. Each listed shattered support has a positioned product cube because all input shores and both test sides are ample, so the output is ample.
